newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-BENSON AND HEDGES CUP SEMIFINALS RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BENSON AND HEDGES CUP SEMIFINALS RESULTS.

text.p: Results of Benson and Hedges Cup Semifinals on Tuesday:
At Canterbury: Kent beat Northamptonshire by 66 runs. Kent 206-8 in 50 overs (T.Ward 78). Northamptonshire 140 all out in 46 overs (P.Strang 4-29).
At The Oval: Surrey beat Leicestershire by 130 runs. Surrey 308-8 in 50 overs (A.Stewart 87, G.Thorpe 79, A.Hollioake 63). Leicestershire 178 all out in 45.3 overs (P.Nixon 53, M.Bicknell 4-41).
